definition: Lowe syndrome, also called oculocerebrorenal syndrome, is an inherited sex-linked recessive disorder that affects the eyes, nervous system, and kidneys. It commonly involves cataracts present at birth, cognitive impairment, kidney tubular problems, and scoliosis, and is linked to a deficiency in an enzyme involved in phosphatidylinositol metabolism and inositol signaling.
